messages:
Ivy (docs): Heads-up I'm working on a migration mini-guide for the FirstRun quickstart: show SDK v2 snippets, update curl auth header, add a tiny GitHub Actions publish step, and include Docker Compose dev instructions.
Marco (devex): Nice. Can you also show a one-line mapping table from old v1 calls to v2? That helps engineers update quickly.
Ivy (docs): Yup, adding a compact table and a short labeled example: v1 `client.generate()` -> v2 `client.chat.create()` (brief explanation inline).
Chen Li: Please standardize on REDWOOD_API_KEY env var. Also remove the old note about X-API-KEY header — that's out of date.
Ivy (docs): Will replace all occurrences. Also changing curl examples to `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
Tara (QA): For deploy examples, can we include docker-compose and a tiny `depends_on` health check? Many users run compose locally.
Ivy (docs): Adding compose snippet with a minimal /health route and a `healthcheck` stanza. Draft:

```yaml
version: '3.8'
services:
  app:
    build: .
    environment:
      - REDWOOD_API_KEY
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:3000/_health"]
      interval: 10s
      retries: 3
```

Marco (devex): Also add a small GitHub Actions workflow that runs the quickstart smoke test on PRs. One job, node setup, install deps, run `node samples/firstrun.js`.
Ivy (docs): Adding short GH Actions snippet and a note about secrets: use `secrets.REDWOOD_API_KEY` in actions to avoid leaking keys.
Chen Li: Could we add a tiny migration checklist: update env var, swap headers, replace generate->chat, check streaming method signatures, and verify healthcheck in container?
Ivy (docs): Added checklist with bullets and links to the SDK reference.
SupportBot: Link-checker: docs/quickstart/firstrun.md -> /api/usage/old resolves 404. Suggest /api/usage/overview.
Ivy (docs): Fixed link and pushed branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/701
Tara (QA): I ran the samples in CI emulator: node sample passed but docker compose needed `--compatibility` on older Docker desktop. Added a side-note for Mac users.
Marco (devex): One more: add a one-sentence note explaining when to use streaming vs non-streaming (UI incremental vs simple responses). Keep it terse.
Ivy (docs): Done; trimmed examples to keep the quickstart concise. Marked PR ready for review.
Chen Li: Quick review done: LGTM aside from a tiny wording nit in the GH Actions comment. I'll push that change to the branch.
Ivy (docs): Thanks all. Will merge after CI green and post a short note in #all-hands about the updated migration tips.
